articles.originalTitle: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen) generally available (GA)
articles.excerpt: Released Gemini 4 Hydrogen (gemini-4-hydrogen), bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone, with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows. Available on the free tier and at paid-tier pricing of $1.50 per 1M input tokens and $7.50 per 1M output tokens, gemini-4-hydrogen introduces a fourth xhigh thinking level alongside low, medium, and default high, and is now the default model for the Antigravity agent in Gemini Managed Agents. See What's new in Gemini 4 Hydrogen for API changes and migration guidance from Gemini 3.8 Flash.

articles.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation
articles.originalTitle: Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation
articles.excerpt: gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated and is no longer available to select in Google AI Studio. Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to gemini-2.5-pro will automatically route to gemini-3.8-flash and be billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates. Before December 1, 2026, update your model string to gemini-3.8-flash and review the Gemini 3.8 Flash migration guide. Breaking API changes include function calling and thought_signature validation, thinking_level replacing thinking_budget, and removed sampling parameters and prefilled model turns.
